variants.headline: Two settlements, different fortunes
body: Between turns {{fromTurn}} and {{toTurn}}, population in {{cityLink}} changed by {{growth}}, while {{otherCityLink}} changed by {{otherGrowth}}.

variants.headline: {{city}} and {{otherCity}} take different paths
body: Our settlements do not move at one pace. Recorded population in {{cityLink}} changed by {{growth}}; in {{otherCity}}, by {{otherGrowth}}, over the comparison ending at turn {{toTurn}}.
A city that grows more slowly may be serving another purpose. Review its food balance and current work before drawing a conclusion.
